module: Milestones based on gameplay statistics (gameplay_statistic): distance traveled (vehicle/total_odometer.length, in m, 8 tiers from 10 to 300 km), career play time (general/mode/career.time, in s, 5 h tiers), rollovers (vehicle/rollover) and airtime (vehicle/airtime.time, in s). majorLinear reward. Notification relies on statistic callbacks registered for the next tier.
notes: registerStastisticCallback (original typo in the name) tests `step < milestone.maxStep` instead of <=: the last tier (8) is never notified.
The callback is registered with gameplay_statistic.callbackRegister and removed with callbackRemove; _statCallback and _callbackTrigger are used to store it.
onGeneralMilestoneClaimed is an alias of registerStastisticCallback: after a claim, the callback is re-registered for the next tier.
onGeneralMilestonesSetupCallbacks declares an unused `milestone` parameter (shadowed by the loop).

onGeneralMilestonesCollect.desc: Hook: builds the four statistic milestones (stat_distance, stat_playtime, stat_rollover, jump) and adds them to milestonesList.

onGeneralMilestonesSetupCallbacks.desc: Hook: registers the statistic callback of each milestone.

clearStatisticCallback.desc: Removes the milestone's statistic callback if it exists.

registerStastisticCallback.desc: Registers a callback triggered when the watched statistic reaches the next tier's target; the callback notifies the milestone and stores notificationStep.

onGeneralMilestoneClaimed.desc: Hook called after a milestone is claimed: alias of registerStastisticCallback to re-register the watching.
